conf.description: Forescout eyeSight/CounterACT Syslog Plugin compliance-text alternate (policy-cef, syslog-raw): envelope-only parse - the compliance body has no vendor grammar and is site-templated.

conf.comment: policy-cef/syslog-raw: Send Message to Syslog compliance alternate to the CEF compliance feed. There is no vendor grammar for the body - it is an operator-composed property-tag template that must be versioned per site - so this pipeline parses only the protocol-level RFC3164 envelope (PRI, timestamp, device id, Message Identity tag) and keeps the compliance body verbatim in message. Extracting host.ip/rule.name/event.outcome from the body would require guessing the site's exact template and is left as a documented gap (README) rather than guessed.

functions.description: why this pipeline stops at the envelope
Parse RFC3164 envelope: optional PRI, header timestamp, optional CounterACT device identifier, syslog tag (Message Identity), message body
batch every status:mapped field that needed no further transform
RFC3164 timestamp has no year/timezone; auto_timestamp infers both from the worker's clock (documented year-rollover risk near 1 Jan - README gap)
observer identity shape branch, PRI facility/severity name decode, event.dataset, cleanup - compliance verdict stays in message (README gap: site template not parsed)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
